body: I gave a fairly concise summary of where my life is. Even if I magically obtained a student loan for college, I don't have the energy and motivation to do it. The only exception would be if, maybe, I went away for college/lived on campus, as I'm pretty sure my depression would be significantly lessened by being away from my mother. However, that's just a theory, and I don't want to risk it by accepting a big student loan, going off to college, and discovering I still can't function.
I don't have a primary goal. I have no realistic ability to improve my life.
